text: Now Sarai,{H8297} Abram's{H87} wife,{H802} bare{H3205} him no{H3808} children:{H3205} and she had a handmaid,{H8198} an Egyptian,{H4713} whose name{H8034} was Hagar.{H1904}

And he went in{H935} unto Hagar,{H1904} and she conceived:{H2029} and when she saw{H7200} that she had conceived,{H2029} her mistress{H1404} was despised{H7043} in her eyes.{H5869}

And Sarai{H8297} said{H559} unto Abram,{H87} My wrong{H2555} be upon thee: I gave{H5414} my handmaid{H8198} into thy bosom;{H2436} and when she saw{H7200} that she had conceived,{H2029} I was despised{H7043} in her eyes:{H5869} Jehovah{H3068} judge{H8199} between me and thee.

And he said,{H559} Hagar,{H1904} Sarai's{H8297} handmaid,{H8198} whence{H335} camest thou?{H935} and whither goest{H3212} thou? And she said,{H559} I am fleeing{H1272} from the face{H6440} of my mistress{H1404} Sarai.{H8297}

And the angel{H4397} of Jehovah{H3068} said{H559} unto her, I will greatly{H7235} multiply{H7235} thy seed,{H2233} that it shall not be numbered{H5608} for multitude.{H7230}

And the angel{H4397} of Jehovah{H3068} said{H559} unto her, Behold,{H2009} thou art with child,{H2030} and shalt bear{H3205} a son;{H1121} and thou shalt call{H7121} his name{H8034} Ishmael,{H3458} because Jehovah{H3068} hath heard{H8085} thy affliction.{H6040}

And she called{H7121} the name{H8034} of Jehovah{H3068} that spake{H1696} unto her, Thou art a God{H410} that seeth:{H7210} for she said,{H559} Have I even here{H1988} looked{H7200} after him{H310} that seeth me?{H7210}
